platform: Windows x64, Abaqus 2025 HF1, bundled Python 3.10.5 / NumPy 1.22.4
method: Three fresh processes per variant per fixture. Sequential rotated variant order, workflow time excludes imports/SDK startup. Same current converter/source with the saved pre-chunk writer or selected chunk size. PVD included; history included on bundled fixtures. No cold OS cache guarantee.
validation: All final per-variant output sets compared byte-for-byte against baseline; all eight baseline/4096 VTU pairs loaded through VTK with matching geometry and arrays.

cprofile_write_calls.note: Separate function profiles of the identical 4-frame scaling workload, including PVD. Counts, not cProfile runtimes, are compared. Baseline count is recorded in python-phase-profile.json.
